text.body:
oṃ tatsadbrahmaṇe namaḥ atha bṛhadyamasmṛtiḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
<1 prathamo'dhyāyaḥ>
atha nānāvidha prāyaścittavarṇanam athāto yamadharmasya prāyaścittaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ prakalpayet ||1|| brāhmaṇastu śunā daṣṭo jambūkena vṛkeṇa vā udite grahanakṣatre dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ śucirbhavet ||2|| jalāgnibandhanabhraṣṭāḥ pravrajyānāśakacyutāḥ viṣaprapannagātrāśca śastrāghātahatāśca ye ||3|| navaite pratyavasitāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ cāndrā yaṇena śudhyanti taptakṛcchradvayena ca ||4|| ubhayāvasitāḥ pāpā ye śāmaśabalācyutāḥ indudvayena śudhyanti dattvā dhenuṃ tathā vṛṣam ||5|| gobrāhmaṇahataṃ da dhaṃ mṛtamudbandhanena tu pāśaṃ chittvā tatastasya taptakṛcchradvayaṃ caret ||6|| kṛmibhirbrahmasaṃyuktaṃ makṣikaiścopaghātitam kṛcchrārdhaṃ saṃprakurvīta śaktyā dadyāttu dakṣiṇām ||7|| cāṇḍālabhāṇḍasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ pītvā bhūmigataṃ jalam gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ ṣaḍrātreṇa viśudhyati ||8|| cāṇḍālaghaṭabhāṇḍasthaṃ yastoyaṃ pibati dvijaḥ tatkṣaṇātkṣipate yastu prājāpatyena śudhyati ||9|| yadi na kṣipate toyaṃ śarīre yasya jīryati prājāpatyaṃ na dātavyaṃ kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanādikam ||10|| caretsāṃtapanaṃ vipraḥ prājāpatyaṃ tu kṣattriyaḥ tadardhaṃ tu caredvaiśyaḥ pādaṃ śūdra sya dāpayet ||11|| cāṇḍālānnaṃ bhakṣayitvā tadvatsalilameva ca māsaṃ kṛcchraṃ caredvipraścāndrā yaṇamathāpi vā ||12|| gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam ||13|| cāṇḍālamūrtikā ye ca ye ca saṃkīrṇayonayaḥ teṣāṃ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret ||14|| cāṇḍālikāsu nārīṣu dvijo maithunakārakaḥ kṛtvāghamarṣaṇaṃ pakṣaṃ śudhyate ca payovratāt ||15|| iti śrīyāmye dharmaśāstre prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
<2 dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ>
atha cāndrā yaṇavidhivarṇanam naṭāṃ śailūṣikāṃ caiva rajakīṃ veṇujīvinīm gatvā cāndrā yaṇaṃ kuryāttathā carmopajīvinīm ||1|| kāpālikānnabhoktṝṇāṃ tanayāgāmināṃ tathā ajñānātkṛcchramuddiṣṭaṃ jñātvā caiva vratadvayam ||2|| surāyāḥ saṃprapānena gomāṃsabhakṣaṇe kṛte taptakṛcchraṃ caredvipro mauñjīhomena śudhyati ||3|| gokṣattriyaṃ tathā vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ cāpyanulomajam jñātvā viśeṣeṇa tataścareccāndrā yaṇaṃ vratam ||4|| kukkuṭāṇḍakamātraṃ tu grāsaṃ ca parikalpayet anyathābhāvadoṣeṇa navameti ca śudhyati ||5|| ekaikaṃ vardhayedgrāsaṃ śukle kṛṣṇe ca hrāsayet amāyāṃ tu na bhuñjīta eṣa cāndrā yaṇo vidhiḥ ||6|| prāyaścittamupakramya kartā yadi vipadyate pūtastadaharedvāpi iha loke paratra ca ||7|| yāvadekaḥ pṛthagbhāvyaḥ prāyaścittaṃ na sevate apraśastā na te spṛśyāste sarve'pi vigarhitāḥ ||8|| abhojyāścāpratigrāhyā asaṃpaṅktyā vivāhikāḥ pūyante tu vrate cīrṇe sarve te rikthabhāginaḥ ||9|| iti śrīyāmye dharmaśāstre dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
<3 tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ>
atha prāyaścittavarṇanam ūnaikādaśavarṣasya pañcavarṣātparasya ca prāyaścittaṃ caredbhrātā pitā vānyo'pi bāndhavaḥ ||1|| ato bālatarasyāpi nāparādho na pātakam rājadaṇḍo na tasyāsti prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||2|| aśītyadhikavarṣāṇi bālo vāpyūnaṣoḍaśaḥ prāyaścittārdhamarhanti striyo vyādhita eva ca ||3|| pitṛvyabhrātṛbhāryāṃ ca bhaginīṃ mātureva ca śvaśrūṃ pitṛṣvasāraṃ ca taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret ||4|| rājñīmācāryaśiṣyāṃ vā upādhyāyasya yoṣitaḥ etā gatvā striyo mohātṣaṇmāsaṃ kṛcchramācaret ||5|| dvau māsau bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca dvau māsau yāvakena tu dvau māsau pañcagavyena ṣaṇmāsaṃ kṛcchramācaret ||6|| mātaraṃ gurupatnīṃ ca svasāraṃ duhitāṃ tathā gatvā tu praviśedagniṃ nānyā śuddhirvidhīyate ||7|| astaṃ gate yadā sūrye cāṇḍālamṛtumatstriyaḥ saṃspṛśettu yadā kaścitprāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ||8|| jātarūpyaṃ suvarṇaṃ tu divāhṛtaṃ ca yajjalam tena snātvā ca pītvā ca gāmālabhya viśudhyati ||9|| dāsanāpitagopālakulamitrārdhasīriṇaḥ ete śūdrā stu bhojyānnā yaścātmānaṃ nivedayet ||10|| asacchūdre ṣu annādyaṃ ye bhuñjantyabudhā dvijāḥ prāyaścittaṃ tathā prāptaṃ careccāndrā yaṇavratam ||11|| yaḥ karotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanaṃ dvijaḥ tadbhakṣaṇe japennityaṃ tribhirvarṣairvyapohati ||12|| vṛṣalīṃ yastu gṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo madamohitaḥ sadā sūtakitā tasya brahmahatyā dine dine ||13|| vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva māsamekaṃ nirantaram iha janmani śūdra tvaṃ punaḥ śvāno bhaviṣyati ||14|| vṛṣalīphenapītasya niḥśvāsopagatasya ca tasyāṃ caiva prasūtasya niṣkṛtirna vidhīyate ||15|| agre māhiṣakaṃ dṛṣṭvā madhye ca vṛṣalīpatim ante vārdhuṣikaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ ||16|| mahiṣītyucyate bhāryā sā caiva vyabhicāriṇī tāndoṣānkṣamate yastu sa vai māhiṣakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||17|| piturgehe tu yā kanyā paśyatyasaṃskṛtā rajaḥ bhrūṇahatyā pitustasya kanyā sā vṛṣalī smṛtā yastāṃ vivāhayetkanyāṃ brāhmaṇo madamohitaḥ asaṃbhāṣyo hyapāṅkteyaḥ sa vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ ||19|| prāpte tu dvādaśe varṣe kanyāṃ yo na prayacchati māsi māsi rajatasyāḥ pitā pibati śoṇitam ||20|| aṣṭavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā ca rohiṇī daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā ||21|| mātā caiva pitā caiva jyeṣṭhabhrātā tathaiva ca trayaste narakaṃ yānti dṛṣṭā kanyāṃ rajasvalām ||22|| samarghaṃ dhanamutsṛjya maharghaṃ yaḥ prayacchati sa vai vārdhuṣiko jñeyo brahmavādiṣu garhitaḥ ||23|| śukrakṣayakarā vandhyā tyājyeti parikīrtitā tasyāstu yo bhavedbhartā taṃ tu vidyādajāvikam ||24|| dūrāchrāntaṃ bhayagrastaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gṛhamāgatam anarcayitvā yo bhuṅkte tatkṣaṇe'sau vidhīyate ||25|| ajāviko māhiṣaśca tathā ca vṛṣalīpatiḥ tṛṇāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭvā savāsā jalamāviśet ||26|| yāvaduṣṇaṃ bhavedannaṃ yāvadbhuñjanti vāgyatāḥ pitarastāvadaśnanti yāvannoktā havirguṇāḥ ||27|| havirguṇā na vaktavyāḥ pitaro yāntyatarpitāḥ pitṛbhistarpitaiḥ paścādvaktavyaṃ śobhanaṃ haviḥ ||28|| yāvato grasate grāsānhavyakavyeṣvamantritaḥ tāvato grasate pretya dīptāngrāsānayomayān ||29|| āsaneṣvāsanaṃ dadyānna tu haste kadācana hasteṣvāsanadāne ca nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ ||30|| āsane pādamārūḍho vastrasyārdhamadhaḥ kṛtam mukhena dhamitaṃ bhuṅkte dvijaścāndrā yaṇaṃ caret ||31|| aṅgulyāṃ yaḥ pavitrāṇi kṛtvā gandhānsamarcayet pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭheta rākṣasairvipralupyati ||32|| hasangrāsaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte saśabdaṃ seṅgitaṃ tathā lehitaṃ vartitaṃ caiva ṣaḍete paṅktidūṣakāḥ ||33|| śvitrī kuṣṭhī tathā śūlī kunakhī śyāvadantakaḥ rogī hīnātiriktāṅgaḥ piśuno matsarī tathā ||34|| durbhago hi tathā ṣaṇḍhaḥ pākhaṇḍī vedanindakaḥ haitukaḥ śūdra yājī ca ayājyānāṃ ca yājakaḥ ||35|| nityaṃ pratigrahe lubdho yācako viṣayātmakaḥ śyāvadanto'tha vaidyaśca asadālāpakastathā ||36|| ete śrāddhe ca dāne ca varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ tathā devalakaścaiva bhṛtako vedavikrayī ||37|| ete varjyāḥ prayatnena evameva yamo'bravīt nirāśāḥ pitarastasya bhavanti ṛṇabhāginaḥ ||38|| atha cenmatravidyukto vaiṣṇavo jñānavānhi saḥ havyakavye niyoktavya iti prāha svayaṃ yamaḥ ||39|| tasmātsarvapratnena śrāddhe yajñe ca karmaṇi adūṣyaṃ caiva viprendraṃ yojanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||40|| tathaiva mantravidyuktaḥ śārīraiḥ paṅktidūṣaṇaiḥ varjitaṃ ca yamaḥ prāha paṅktipāvana eva saḥ ||41|| nirmatsaraḥ sadācāraḥ śrotriyo brahmavidyuvā vidyāvinayasaṃpannaḥ pātrabhūto dvijottamaḥ ||42|| vedāntavijjyeṣṭhasāmā alubdho vedatatparaḥ yojanīyaḥ prayatnena daive pitrye ca karmaṇi yadattaṃ ca hutaṃ tasmai hyanantaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||43|| ucchiṣṭocchiṣṭasaṃspṛṣṭaḥ śunā śūdre ṇa vā dvijaḥ upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati ||44|| ucchiṣṭabhājanaṃ yena vipreṇa cānnavarjitam spṛṣṭaṃ tena pramādācca prājāpatyaṃ samācaret ||45|| ucchiṣṭocchiṣṭasaṃspṛṣṭo brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena hi daśarudrīṃ japetpaścādgāyatryā śodhanaṃ param ||46|| ucchaṣṭocchiṣṭasaṃspṛṣṭaḥ kṣattriyo vaiśya eva ca pramādocchiṣṭa saṃspṛṣṭaḥ śūdre ṇa tu yadā dvijaḥ ||47|| upoṣya rajanī rajanīmekāṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati śvānakukkuṭamārjārāḥ kāko vā spṛśate yadi ||48|| ucchiṣṭaṃ taṃ dvijaṃ yastu ahorātreṇa śudhyati pañcagavyena śuddhiḥ syādityāha bhagavānyamaḥ ||49|| rajasvalāṃ spṛśedyastu trirātraṃ tatra kārayet upoṣya dvijasaṃskāraṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati ||50|| udakyā dṛṣṭipātena śrutaśabdena caiva hi snānaṃ devārcanaṃ dānaṃ havanaṃ ca praṇaśyati ||51|| raktavastrasya vikretā lākṣārajakameva ca veṇujīvanakaivartatakṣacarmopajīvinaḥ ||52|| eteṣāṃ sparśanātpāpaṃ tathā caiva tu mohitaḥ pratigrahācca vipro vai narakaṃ prati gacchati ||53|| udakyāḥ sparśane caiva brāhmaṇo vai pramādataḥ ṣaḍrātropoṣitaḥ snātvā pañcagavyena śudhyati ||54|| sūtake vartamāne'pi dāsavargasya kā kriyā svāmitulyaṃ bhavettasya sūtakaṃ tu praśasyate ||55|| yanna kārayate tattannānyaṃ pratyabravīdyamaḥ vivāhotsavayajñeṣu kārye caivamupasthite ||56|| rajaḥ paśyati yā nārī tasya kālasya kā kriyā vipule ca jale snātvā śuklavāsāstvalaṃkṛtā ||57|| āpohiṣṭhetyṛgabhiṣiktāyaṃ gauriti vā ṛcaḥ pūjānte homayetpaścād ghṛtāhutyā śatāṣṭakam ||58|| gāyatryā vyāhṛtibhiśca tataḥ karma samācaret yāvaddvijā na cārcyante annadānahiraṇyakaiḥ ||59|| tāvaccīrṇavratasyāpi tatpāpaṃ na praṇaśyati ||60|| yaddehakaṃ kākabalākacillāmedhyena liptaṃ tu bhavetkadācit śrotre mukhe vā parimastake vā jñānena lepopahatasya śuddhiḥ ||61|| abhakṣyāṇāmapeyānāmalehyānāṃ ca bhakṣaṇe retomūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ||62|| padmodumbarabilvānāṃ kuśāśvatthapalāśayoḥ eteṣāmudakaṃ pītvā pañcagavyena śudhyati ||63|| strīṇāṃ rajasvalānāṃ ca sparśaścaiva bhavedyadi caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ||64|| spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ sagotrā cānyagotrakā kāmādakāmato vāpi trirātrācchuddhiriṣyate ||65|| spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī kṣattriyā tathā ardhakṛcchraṃ caretpūrvā pādakṛcchraṃ tathottarā ||66|| spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī vaiśyinī tathā pādahīnaṃ caretpūrvā pādamekaṃ tathottarā ||67|| spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī śūdri ṇī tathā kṛcchreṇa śudhyate śūdrī brāhmī dānena śudhyati ||68|| vipraḥ spṛṣṭo niśāyāṃ tūdakyāyā patitena vā divānītena toyena snāpayedagnisaṃnidhau ||69|| divā caivārkasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ rātrau nakṣatradarśanāt saṃdhyayorubhayorvāpi pavitraṃ sarvadā jalam ||70|| iti śrīyāmye dharmaśāstre tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
<4 caturtho'dhyāyaḥ>
atha govadhaprāyaścittavarṇanam svātaṃ vāpī tathā kūpapāṣāṇe śastraghātite yaṣṭyā tu ghātite caiva mṛtpiṇḍānyeva sādhayet ||1|| govadhe caiva yatpāpaṃ balīvardasya caiva hi prāyaścittaṃ bhavettatra striyā vā puruṣasya vā ||2|| khāte ca patitā yā gauḥ kūpe vā cāvaṭe'pi vā āśāvālakuḍe vāpi śastraghātena caiva hi ||3|| yaṣṭyā tu patitā yā gaurbalīvardo mṛto'pi vā vatso vatsataro vāpi prāyaścittī bhavennaraḥ ||4|| nārī vāpi kumāro vā prāyaścittādviśudhyati pāpī prakhyāpayetpāpaṃ dattvā dhenuṃ tathā vṛṣam ||5|| pracchannapāpino ye syuḥ kṛtaghnā duṣṭacāriṇaḥ narakeṣu ca pacyante yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ||6|| tasmācca pāpinā grāhyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathā tathā pramādācca hatā yena kapilā vā tathetarā ||7|| yathā brahmavadhe pāpaṃ kapilāyā vadhe tathā balīvarde'pi ca tathā prāyaścittaṃ samaṃ smṛtam ||8|| rodhane bandhane caiva mṛtpiṇḍanagomaye utkṛṣṭenāpi gohantā prāyaścittena śudhyati ||9|| muṣṭyā vā nihatā yā gauḥ śakaṭe dhāripaṅkayoḥ govartapatitā gāvaḥ śvanadyāmuttare'pi vā ||10|| etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gavāṃ ca ghātamuttamam yatra yatra mriyedgauśca prāyaścittaṃ pṛthakpṛthak ||11|| vane ca patitā yā gauḥ pāmaratrāṭaśaṅkitā mṛtā caiva yadā sā gauḥ prāyaścittī bhavecca saḥ ||12|| preṣitaḥ puruṣo vāpi prāyaścittaṃ ca yatsmṛtam ābdikaṃ caiva śūdra sya vaiśyasya dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||13|| triguṇaṃ kṣattriyasyaiva viprasyaiva caturguṇam goṣṭhe nivasanaṃ kāryaṃ goghno'hamiti vācayet ||14|| kaṣṭena vatamāno'pi kālenaiva śucirbhavet gavāṃ madhye vasedrā trau divā gā vai hyanutrajet ||15|| na strīṇāṃ vapanaṃ kuryānna ca govrajanaṃ smṛtam na ca goṣṭhe vasedrā trau na kuryādvaidikīṃ śrutim ||16|| sarvānkeśānsamucchritya cchedayedaṅguladvayam eṣa eva tu nārīṇāṃ śiromuṇḍāpanaṃ smṛtam ||17|| sūtake mṛtake caiva vidhiṃ prabrūhi no yama jātake vartamāne'pi mṛtakaṃ ca yadā bhavet ||18|| ko vidhiḥ sa vinirdiṣṭaḥ kathayasva yathātatham evamukto hi bhagavānyamaḥ prāha yathātatham ||19|| jātake naiva mṛtakaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ pūrvatratamanirdiṣṭaṃ mayā ca sūtakaṃ bhavet ||20|| sūtakena na lipyeta iti prāha svayaṃ yamaḥ sūtakena na lipyeta vrataṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ vrajet ||21|| śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo yajño devatārādhanaṃ tathā brahmahā ca surāpaśca svarṇasteyī gurudruhaḥ ||22|| saṃsargī pañcamo jñeyastatsamo nātra saṃśayaḥ eteṣu dvādaśābdaṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ||23|| tathā pātakināṃ caiva ṣaḍabdaṃ caiva saṃsmṛtam upapātakināṃ caiva tripañcābdaṃ vidhīyate ||24|| prājāpatyaistribhiḥ kṛcchraṃ kṛcchraṃ vai dvādaśābdikam ekabhaktaṃ tathā naktamupavāsamathāpi vā ||25|| etaddinacatuṣkeṇa pādakṛcchraśca jāyate tripādakṛcchro vijñeyaḥ pāpakṣayakaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||26|| dharmaśāstrānusāreṇa prāyaścittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ dātavyaṃ pāpamuktyarthaṃ prāṇināṃ pāpakāriṇām ||27|| anutāpādyapo yadā puṃsāṃ bhavedvai pāpinaḥ prāyaścittaṃ tadā deyamityāha bhagavānyamaḥ ||28|| ajñātvā dharmaśāstrāṇi prāyaścittaṃ dadāti yaḥ prāyaścittī bhavetpūtastatpāpaṃ parṣadaṃ vrajet ||29|| tasmācchāstrānusāreṇa prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate aṣṭaśālyāṃ mṛtā ye ca ye ca strīsūtake mṛtāḥ ||30|| draṃ ṣṭrābhirbhakṣitā ye ca ye ca ātmahano janāḥ aṣṭaśālyāṃ mṛto vipraḥ prāyaścittaṃ tu bandhubhiḥ ||31|| kāryaṃ tu ābdikaṃ caiva tathā strīṇāṃ ca dāpayet śuddhyarthaṃ nānyathā bhāvyamityāha bhagavānyamaḥ ||32|| durmṛtyumaraṇaṃ prāptā ye'pyadhogatimāgatāḥ teṣāṃ śuddhyarthamevātra dvitryabdaṃ hi viśiṣyate ||33|| brāhmaṇakṣattriyaviśāṃ śūdrā ṇāṃ cāntyajātinām tāratamyena dātavyamiti prāha svayaṃ yamaḥ ||34|| patitānāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ vigarhitam kathaṃ śuddhirbhavettāsāṃ teṣāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ||35|| vyabhicārādṛtau śuddhiḥ strīṇāṃ caiva na saṃśayaḥ garbhe jāte parityāgo nānyathā mama bhāṣitam ||36|| duṣṭastrīdarśanenaiva pitaro yāntyadhogatim ghṛtaṃ yonyāṃ kṣipedghoraṃ parapuṃsagatā hi yā ||37|| havanaṃ ca prayatnena gāyatryā cāyutatrayam brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścācchatamaṣṭottareṇa hi ||38|| vidhavā caiva yā nārī puṃsopagatasevinī tyājyā sā bandhubhiścaiva nānyathā yamabhāṣitam ||39|| patitasya ca viprasya anutāparatasya ca pāpāccaiva nivṛttasya prāyaścitī bhavettadā ||40|| tāratamyena dātavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi sakāmo hi yadā vipraḥ pāpācāraparo bhavet ||41|| dṛṣṭvā nivṛttapāpaughaḥ prāyaścittī tadārhati tathā kṣattriyavaiśyau vā śūdrā vāpi yathākramāt ||42|| vidhavāgamane pāpaṃ sakṛccaiva tu yadbhavet asakṛcca yadā jñātvā prāyaścittaṃ pravartate ||43|| asakṛdgamanāccaiva careccāndrā yaṇadvayam sakṛdgagane yatpāpaṃ prājāpatyadvayena hi ||44|| punarbhūrvikṛtā yena kṛtā vipreṇa caiva hi vinā śākhāprabhedena punarbharbhaṇyate hi sā ||45|| savarṇaśca savarṇāyāmabhiṣikto yadā bhavet brāhmaṇaḥ kāmalubdho'pi śrāddhe yajñe ca garhitaḥ ||46|| kṣattriyo brāhmaṇīsaktaḥ kṣattriṇyāṃ viśa eva vā vaiśyāyā gamane śūdraḥ patitāyā bhavānyathā ||47|| prātilomye mahatpāpaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ prāyaścittaṃ cānulomye na bhavatyeva cānyathā ||48|| mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ pātakaṃ smṛtam tasmātpāpādviśuddhyarthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ dine dine ||49|| prātaḥ saṃdhyāṃ sanakṣatrāmupāsyāmeva yatnataḥ madhyāhne ca tathā raudrīṃ sāyaṃ caiva tu vaiṣṇavīm ||50|| trividhaṃ pāpaśuddhyarthaṃ saṃdhyopāsanameva ca saṃdhyāhīno hi yo vipraḥ snānahīnastathaiva ca ||51|| snānahīno malāśī syātsaṃdhyāhīno hi bhrūṇahā naiśaṃ pāpaṃ hi yāṃ dhyātvā upāsanaparo hi saḥ ||52|| brahmalokaṃ vrajatyeva nānyathā yamabhāṣitam vidyātapobhyāṃ saṃyuktaḥ śāntaḥ śuciralampaṭaḥ ||53|| alubdhāhlādaniṣpāpā bhūdevā nātra saṃśayaḥ pātrībhūtāśca vijñeyā viprāste nātra saṃśayaḥ ||54|| tebhyo dattamanantaṃ hi ityāha bhagavānyamaḥ kukarmasthāstu ye viprā lolupā vedavarjitāḥ ||55|| saṃdhyāhīnā vratabhraṣṭāḥ piśunā viṣayātmakāḥ tebhyo dattaṃ niṣphalaṃ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||56|| pratigrahe saṃkucitā yadānyātaiyavidhṛtā bhūmidarśanātpāpamocakākṛtatretādvāpare kalau nauvarvīroṣitaḥ ||57|| rājapratigrahātsarvaṃ brahmavarcasameva ca naśyatīti na saṃdeha ityāha bhagavānyamaḥ ||58|| rājñāṃ pratigrahastyājyo lokatrayajigīṣubhiḥ rājñaḥ pratigrahāccaiva brāhmaṇyaṃ hi vilupyate ||59|| gāvo dūrapracāreṇa hiraṇyaṃ lobhalipsayā strī vinaśyati garbheṇa brāhmaṇo rājasevayā ||60|| sevakāścāpi viprāṇāṃ rājñāṃ sukṛtanāmabhiḥ kumbhīpākeṣu pacyante yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ||61|| asevyāsevino viprā ayājyānāṃ ca yājakāḥ apāṅktāste ca vijñeyāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ ||62|| iti śrīyāmye dharmaśāstre caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
<5 pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ>
atha śrāddhakāle patnyāṃ rajasvalāyāṃ nirṇayaḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ sarveṣāmantyajātīnāṃ varṇādīnāṃ yathākramam ||1|| strīsaṃparkādikaṃ sarvaṃ jātamantyajasaṃjñakam yonisaṃkarajaṃ sarvaṃ varṇataścāpi sarvaśaḥ ||2|| viprakṣattriyaviṭśūdrā varṇijātyeṣvanukramāt ete brāhmaṇakutsāḥ syustasmādbrāhmaṇamuttamam ||3|| vedācārarato vipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ tairapyanuṣṭhito dharma uktaścaiva viśeṣataḥ ||4|| kārye caiva viśeṣeṇa tribhirvarṇairatandri taḥ balāddāsīkṛtā ye ca mlecchacāṇḍāladasyubhiḥ ||5|| aśubhaṃ kāritāḥ karma gavādiprāṇihiṃsanam prāyaścittaṃ ca dātavyaṃ tāratamyena vā dvijaiḥ ||6|| śrāddhakāle yadā jātā patnī yasya rajasvalā prasūtā vā na kārye ca daivikaṃ paitṛkaṃ tathā ||7|| brāhmaṇā mantritāścaiva kṣaṇitā vā prayatnataḥ uddiśya pitṛpākaṃ ca kāryaṃ paitṛkameva tat ||8|| aśaucaṃ na bhavatyeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā prasthāne vā pitā tasya pañcatvaṃ ca gato bhavet ||9|| śrāddhādikaṃ tu putreṇa ajñātena kṛtaṃ yadā kanyāpradānasamaye śrutaṃ ca pitaraṃ mṛtam ||10|| kanyādānaṃ ca tatkāryaṃ vacanādbhavate kṣamaḥ pituḥ pātrādikaṃ karma paścātsarvaṃ yathāvidhi ||11|| ajñānācca kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ daivikaṃ paitṛkaṃ ca yat jātake sūtake vāpi tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ||12|| vyāsenoktasmṛtau svakīye ajñānātpitari mṛte yadā jñātusadaivakāryaṃ pitṛkameva vā ||13|| aneke yasya ye putrāḥ saṃsṛṣṭā hi bhavanti ca jyeṣṭhena hi kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ saphalaṃ paitṛkaṃ bhavet ||14|| vaidikaṃ ca tathā sarvaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ pṛthakpiṇḍaṃ pṛthakśrāddhaṃ vaiśvadevādikaṃ ca yat ||15|| bhrātaraśca pṛthakkuryurnāvibhaktāḥ kadācana aputrasya ca putrāḥ syuḥ kartāraḥ sāṃparāyaṇāḥ ||16|| saphalaṃ jāyate sarvamiti śātātapo'bravīt na ca datto ahīno'tisnehena ca tathāparaḥ ||17|| balādgṛhīto baddhaśca bandhubhirdatta eva ca bhrātuḥ putro mitraputraḥ śiṣyaścaiva tathaurasaḥ ||18|| aputrasya ca vijñeyā dāyādā nātra saṃśayaḥ navaite putravatpālyāḥ paralokapradā hyamī ||19|| aurasena samājñeyā vacasoddālakasya ca idānīṃ bhāganirṇeyamṛṣiḥ śātātapo'bravīt ||20|| jyeṣṭhena vā kaniṣṭhena vibhāgasya vinirṇayaḥ samabhāgapradātā ca aputrebhyo na saṃśayaḥ ||21|| samabhāgo grahītavyaḥ putramatyā sadaiva hi pitṛbhyo bhrātṛputrebhyo dāyādebhyo yathākramāt ||22|| adhikasya ca bhāgau dvāvitarebhyaḥ samāsataḥ ādhau pratigrahe krānte pūrvā tu balavattarā ||23|| sarveṣveva vivādeṣu balavatyuttarā kriyā samavidyottaraṃ caiva pratyavaskandanaṃ tathā ||24|| pūrvaṃ nyāsavidhiścaiva uttaraḥ syāccaturvidhaḥ sākṣiṣūbhayataḥ satsu sākṣiṇaḥ pūrvavādinaḥ ||25|| pūrvapakṣe'dharībhūte bhavantyuttaravādinaḥ asākṣivyavahāreṣu divyaṃ deyaṃ yathāvidhi ||26|| iti śrīyāmye dharmaśāstre pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
samāpteyaṃ bṛhadyamasmṛtiḥ
